resources.string: The password stays in this session only. Enter the deployment base URL. Configure sensitive handling in Settings.
Show and Hide keep the notification shade open; Copy closes it. Unlock before showing or copying.
Enable masked inbox previews and actions for background messages. The inbox still saves messages if permission is denied.
Incoming marked sensitive content replaces the clipboard and may be read by other apps.
Only the latest inbox item is kept. Unmarked text cannot reliably be identified as sensitive.
Changes apply to the active session. Receive-only clears old upload candidates; committed requests cannot be undone.
These three exclusive choices apply to marked sensitive content. Ordinary messages write the clipboard according to direction. Unmarked text cannot reliably be identified as sensitive.
Content is hidden by default and stored in the local encrypted inbox.

Android 15 and later limit cumulative dataSync foreground service time. Shizuku does not remove this limit. The system may delay or stop the service. Reconnect after task removal or restart; account passwords are not saved.
This permanently deletes this locally saved sensitive message.
Connect in the foreground to start background operation
Connect to receive marked sensitive messages.
Initial registration does not replay old messages. Leaving the foreground closes the session unless background operation is enabled.
Only explicitly marked sensitive messages enter the inbox. Select the encrypted inbox policy first.
Uses the desktop core regex engine. Rejected content enters neither the clipboard nor the sensitive inbox. Saving changed rules clears old local upload candidates.
Tests this draft without network requests.

Continue in the selected direction after leaving the app. Receiving ordinary messages writes the clipboard.

Continue sending and receiving in the selected direction. Incoming ordinary text may replace a recent copy from another app. Marked sensitive content follows its separate policy. Reading new background copies requires separate Shizuku authorization.
Applies in the foreground and background. Send only never receives; receive only never uploads local content; two-way does both.

Install and start Shizuku 13 or later, then authorize access. The source binds only while background operation is active and the direction includes sending. It does not read while locked or the screen is off. Without access, only already-owned uploads continue; receiving remains available.
